notes:
### The menu-bar battery now follows the cable straight away

Plugging in or unplugging could leave the icon showing the old state for up to 45 seconds, because what the helper was doing (holding or draining) was only re-checked every 30 seconds. The app now asks the helper the moment the cable changes, and once you unplug, the icon stops treating the battery as still on the charger. The unplug sound and haptic, which that stale state could silence, now play again.

### The menu-bar panel no longer stops responding after eWiz has been running a while

After hours of running, the panel could open looking normal while every button, toggle and mode in it did nothing until eWiz was restarted. The panel is now built fresh each time it opens, so it can't go stale. It also opens fully on screen at the right edge, no longer flickers when switching modes, and keeps a failed helper install's error visible after the password prompt closes it.
